create_Rot3Array_from_quaternion: create a Rot3Array rotation matrix from w, x, y, z quaternion components with optional normalization
build_Rot3Array_from_svd: build a Rot3Array rotation matrix by projecting an arbitrary 3x3 matrix using SVD decomposition
apply_Rot3Array_to_point: apply a Rot3Array rotation to a Vec3Array point and return the transformed 3D coordinates
compose_Rot3Array_matmul: compose two Rot3Array rotation matrices together using the matmul operator to chain rotations
create_Rot3Array_from_two_vectors: create a Rot3Array rotation frame from two Vec3Array vectors where e0 aligns to the x-axis
